title: Quarantine Tank Observation and Feeding Log
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), auto-top-off events (`ato:event`), dosing and feeding events (`doser:event`, `reeftank:feeding`), planted-tank CO2 (`plantedtank:co2`), quarantine observations (`quarantine:observation`), frag lighting (`fraglight:reading`), and leak telemetry (`leaksensor:event`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, GHL, ESPHome, leak sensors, dosing systems, planted-tank controllers, quarantine logs, and PAR meters streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=quarantine:observation
| stats sum(feeding_ok) as successful_feedings count as checks by specimen issue_flag
| sort - checks
description: Summarises quarantine observations, feeding success, and issue flags by specimen.
value: Quarantine is only useful when it is consistent, and an audit log keeps the health routine visible instead of ad hoc.
implementation: Log each quarantine check with a specimen identifier, whether feeding succeeded, and any issue flag that was observed.
visualization: Table of checks, successful feedings, and issue flags by specimen.
grandmaExplanation: It maps how each fish or coral in quarantine is doing and whether feeding and observation are staying consistent.
